readout_other: Single-unit conduction delay of electrically evoked action potentials in split sciatic nerve filaments; transmission electron microscopy
direction_notes: Ultrasound did not evoke action potentials directly but progressively increased conduction velocity of A- and C-fibres, more at higher intensity and duration, reversing within minutes.
safety_notes: TEM showed no apparent structural difference among control and up to 102.31 W/cm2 nerves; focal temperature change below 1 C.

exposures.label: Focused pulsed ultrasound to excised mouse sciatic nerve, 1.1 MHz

target.label: the ~2 mm middle segment of the sciatic nerve

timing.protocol_description: 90 electrical stimuli at 0.5 Hz: 20 pre-US, 20 during US (FPUS for 40 s), 50 post-US; one intensity per protocol with at least 5 min between protocols.

source_quotes.n_subjects: A total of62 fibers recorded from 15 mice were tested with the 20–20–50 protocol; each fiber was assessed with at least one ofthe 4 FPUS stimulus intensities along with a control (zero FPUS stimuli); each intensity was tested in at least 20 fibers.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: A focused US transducer (H-101G, Sonic Concepts, Washington, USA) with a center frequency of 1.1 MHz was used to deliver FPUS to the sciatic nerve in vitro.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: An arbitrary waveform generator (BK Precision 4054, Yorba Linda, CA) was used to deliver square pulses (200 ns pulse width, 200 kHz pulse repetition frequency [PRF]) to a radiofrequency (RF) power amplifier (A-300, Electronics & Innovation, Rochester, NY) via an adjustable attenuator (50DR-046, JFW Industries, Indianapolis, IN).
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: An arbitrary waveform generator (BK Precision 4054, Yorba Linda, CA) was used to deliver square pulses (200 ns pulse width, 200 kHz pulse repetition frequency [PRF]) to a radiofrequency (RF) power amplifier (A-300, Electronics & Innovation, Rochester, NY) via an adjustable attenuator (50DR-046, JFW Industries, Indianapolis, IN).
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: Spontaneous firing activities were not detected in the in vitro sciatic nerve. FPUS of 40 s alone at all four intensities (0.91, 2.99, 14.5 and $2 8 . 2 \mathrm { W } / \mathrm { c m } ^ { 2 } )$ did not evoke any neural action potential in the sciatic nerve with examples of the lowest and highest intensity as shown in figures 3(B) and (C), respectively.

flags.reason: The 200 ns / 200 kHz figures describe the electrical square pulses to the amplifier; the transducer response is stated as several cycles, about 6 microseconds. Converted 200 ns to 0.0002 ms as written.
Intensity from hydrophone-derived calculation in a water chamber; domain not explicitly named. Text also mentions 65.2/65.5 and 102.31 W/cm2 for temperature and histology only.
62 fibres from 15 mice for the main protocol; 4 further nerves used for histology.
Conclusion lists 0.99 W/cm2 in places, results text lists 0.91; 0.91 recorded.
